name: Spiritual Growth
overview: Spiritual growth is depicted in Scripture as a hunger and thirst for righteousness that God promises to satisfy, reflecting a deep desire for holiness and godly living. Believers are encouraged to seek the fruit of the Spirit—qualities such as love, joy, peace, and faith—that evidence transformation through the Spirit's work. Confidence is given that God, who began this good work in each believer, will faithfully complete it until Christ's return. Prayer and a continual pursuit of wisdom and spiritual understanding are essential for being filled with the knowledge of God's will as part of this ongoing process.
